note: Evaluated top to bottom, first match wins, case-insensitive. 'question' gets 0.6 confidence, everything else 0.9, no match is 'unknown' at 0.0.

rules.label: bounce
rules.pattern: mailer-daemon|delivery status notification|550 5\.\d\.\d|address not found|does not exist

rules.label: out_of_office
rules.pattern: out of (the )?office|\booo\b|on vacation|limited access to email

rules.label: not_now
rules.pattern: contract until|after the holidays|reach out (to me )?(then|in|next|after)|ping me in|not right now|circle back|next (quarter|year)|\bin (january|february|march|april|may|june|july|august|september|october|november|december)\b

rules.label: wrong_person
rules.pattern: not the right person|wrong person|handles (the )?(payments|that|this)|reach out to (?!me\b)\w+|talk to \w+ instead

rules.label: interested
rules.pattern: here (is|are)|attached|sounds good|i'?m interested|send it over|let's talk|^(sure|yes|ok|okay)\b

bounce.note: Mark email invalid, suppress, re-verify the domain list.

out_of_office.note: Pause sequence, resume the day after they return.

unsubscribe.note: Add to suppression list. Do not contact on any channel.

wrong_person.note: Create contact for the referred person and send step 1 to them.

meeting_request.note: Confirm the time, send invite, create opportunity.

not_now.note: Stop sequence, set follow-up task on the date they gave.

not_interested.note: Stop sequence. Recycle in 180 days if a new signal appears.

question.note: Draft an answer for approval, keep sequence paused.

interested.note: Draft reply for approval today, create opportunity.

unknown.note: Send to Claude classifier, then human review.
